title: Supplied restricted adjunction data and the specified five-arrow Hom chain
statement: Fix the finite-field datum, finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, integer $n\geq1$, finite-type geometric schemes and six-functor datum $S$ of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Choose one of the four stages $s$ and its finite-Tor full domains $\mathcal C_X,\mathcal C_Y$ using [def-sf-ctf-coefficient-stage-selectors]. Let $f:X\to Y$ have a chosen compactification $c$. A supplied restricted-adjunction presentation $R$ consists of preservation of these domains by the four recorded functors $f^*,Rf_*,Rf_!,f^!$, symmetric closed presentations of the recorded internal Hom on both domains, and natural tensor comparison isomorphisms identifying their left-factor tensors through full inclusion with the recorded partial tensors. The pull/direct/support/exceptional functors are the full-subcategory restrictions, and their ordinary and exceptional adjunctions are the fully faithful restrictions of the specified adjunctions [fix-prop-adjunctions]. The left-factor tensor-Hom adjunctions are obtained from the supplied closed presentations using their symmetry. For separated finite-type $f$, $M\in\mathcal C_X$ and $N,T\in\mathcal C_Y$, use the actual forward projection $P_{M,T}$ and fixed-left Hom functors $H^X_M,H^Y_{Rf_!M}$ of [def-pod-ctf-pairing-maps]. Define $A_M=f_*\circ H^X_M\circ f^!$ and $B_M=H^Y_{Rf_!M}$ as functors of $N$. Define $\Gamma_{M,N,T}:\operatorname{Hom}(T,A_MN)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(T,B_MN)$ to be the composite of inverse ordinary adjunction, inverse left-factor tensor-Hom adjunction, inverse exceptional adjunction, precomposition with forward $P_{M,T}$, and target left-factor tensor-Hom adjunction, in that order. This is supplied data and a specified composite, with no assertion of existence of a restricted presentation and no theorem about the composite.
